.. change::
    :tags: feature, orm

    Added :paramref:`_orm.selectinload.limit`, allowing
    :func:`_orm.selectinload` to eagerly load a limited number of objects for
    each parent collection.  The loader supports one-to-many and many-to-many
    relationships, composite primary keys, additional loader criteria, nested
    eager loaders, and deterministic tie-breaking using related object
    primary keys.  Partial collections are not marked as user-modified, and
    existing collections are replaced only when ``populate_existing()`` is
    used.  The feature requires window function support in the target
    database.
